item.title: Prince Albert’s Hudak named one of five ski team co-captains ahead of 2026 Paralympic Games
item.description: Prince Albert’s Brittany Hudak was named one of five co-captains for the Milano Cortina 2026 Canadian Paralympic Ski Team. Hudak is set to make her fourth Paralympic Games appearance.
